intro.p1: I joined 42 in 2024 after a technical baccalaureate. What drives me is always wanting to understand how things really work, rather than settling for the fact that they do.

moncab_internship.description: Sole dev intern, autonomous on the whole codebase within 3-4 weeks. Invitation system, v2 search algorithm (weighted score over 6 criteria), Pennylane invoicing (dynamic VAT, webhooks), listing syndication via Ubiflow, owner dashboard, several Stripe security passes. On the automation side, I set up the n8n architecture behind every email: prospecting, follow-ups, notifications. 263 commits in 6 months.

moncab_apprentice.description: The internship continues as an apprenticeship alongside 42. I keep evolving the product and the n8n automations, with and without AI (Supabase, Airtable): between 40 and 50 automations built or taken over since I joined. The main follow-up workflow handles 80 to 110 users every day.

school42.description: Common core completed, now at Transcender rank (level 12). I went from low level, with a shell in C and an IRC server in C++, to real-time web (ft_transcendence), mobile (Music Room) and machine learning coded from scratch (linear regression, Q-learning). Awarded Great Tutor for helping other students, I also ran a series of talks on AI there. Goal: the RNCP level 7 Data / Web / AI degree, alongside the apprenticeship.

school42_volunteer.description: Tutoring during the Piscine (the admission bootcamp), coding introductions during the Piscine Discovery, six open days, student fairs and proctoring four exam sessions.

home.kicker: Fullstack developer · École 42 Angoulême · apprentice at Moncab
home.lead: I build web products and automations, and I teach others to code with AI without losing their own skills.

projects.title: Projects
projects.personal_subtitle: Tools built for myself and for other students.
projects.school_subtitle: Low level, networking, system design: 42's project-based learning.

setupkit.title: SetupKit
setupkit.description: Config generator for AI coding tools (CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, AGENTS.md, commands, skills), tailored to a team's stack and habits. Beta now paused: it mostly taught me SEO and how to launch a product.

minishell.title: Minishell
minishell.description: Unix command interpreter in C. Execution, redirections, pipes, environment variables, signal handling.

irc.title: IRC
irc.description: IRC server in C++ with non-blocking TCP sockets. Multi-client handling, authentication, channels, real-time messaging.

transcendence.title: Transcendence
transcendence.description: Full-stack web app. Real-time multiplayer Pong via WebSockets, auth, chat, stats, match history.

music_room.title: Music_Room
music_room.description: Mobile music sharing app in React Native and Node.js. Collaborative playlists, events, voting, personalized profiles.

learn2slither.title: Learn2Slither
learn2slither.description: A snake that learns to survive and feed autonomously using Q-Learning. Local vision, Q-table, exploration/exploitation, trained from scratch with no ML library.

linear_regression.title: Linear_Regression
linear_regression.description: Car price prediction program using linear regression with gradient descent algorithm, implemented from scratch in Python.

open42.title: Open42
open42.description: My teaching-oriented AI harness for 42 students, being rebuilt on an open-source fork of OpenCode. I am turning it into a "teacher harness" that carries all my learning logic, with mentor agents (tutor, architect, reviewer, AI coach) that guide without handing out the answer.

hypertube.title: ft_hypertube
hypertube.description: BitTorrent client written from scratch in TypeScript (tracker, handshake, piece exchange, SHA-1 verification) for video streaming. In progress.

Mira.title: Mira
Mira.description: Consent-first AI agent that helps victims of non-consensual intimate imagery (NCII, sexual deepfakes) get content removed under EU law (DSA Article 16), without ever having to view the material, hunt down the host or write legal text. Four-stage pipeline: Mandate, Locate, Analyze, Notify. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, FastAPI, Playwright and Gemini 2.5 Computer Use. RAISE Hackathon 2026, team of five.
Mira.role: Repository owner and main contributor (~46 commits) in a team of five. I defined the API contracts, built the Computer Use harness and coordinated five parallel Claude sessions through a shared team CLAUDE.md.

Cellule_rouge.title: Cellule Rouge
Cellule_rouge.description: One-day consulting mission for Cellule Rouge, a start-up designing textile solutions for people with implanted ports. As a pair: SEO/GEO and PageSpeed audit, four-phase roadmap, and an n8n monitoring pipeline (RSS, PubMed) with Gemini-assisted writing and human review before publishing. Neoloji x 42 Angoulême challenge.
Cellule_rouge.role: I delivered all the technical work: SEO/GEO and PageSpeed audits (84 mobile, 99 desktop), roadmap, n8n monitoring pipeline and a review back-office built into the site.

learn_with_ai.title: Learning with AI
learn_with_ai.description: Concrete methods to use AI as a tutor rather than an answer machine: the CRAFT method, the 4D framework, stable versus adaptive context.

code_with_ai.title: Learning to code with AI
code_with_ai.description: What separates a developer's vibe coding from a non-developer's, and how to stay in control of your code. Worked example: my teaching-oriented CLAUDE.md.

full_setup.title: My setup, end to end
full_setup.description: Claude Code configuration, MCP, harness, agents, n8n automations and CI/CD: the setup I use every day, explained piece by piece.

help.title: Need help with AI?

use_ai.title: Using AI in your work
use_ai.description: Choosing and setting up your tools (Claude Code, agents, n8n automations), framing your prompts and context, knowing when AI saves time and when it costs you some.

learn_with_ai.title: Mastering learning with AI
learn_with_ai.description: Making it a tutor rather than a crutch: methods to actually progress, understand what the AI produces and stay in control of what you learn.
